title: Office & Commercial Movers in Glendora | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Need commercial movers in Glendora you can book by the hour? Staged office relocation, a COI for your landlord, crews every day between 8AM and 6PM.
heroSubtitle: Office relocation planned around your building rules and moved in stages, so your team keeps working.

faq.question: Can you move our Glendora office over a weekend?
faq.answer: Yes. Crews work Monday through Sunday between 8AM and 6PM, so a Saturday and a Sunday give two full days in a quiet building and staff come back to finished desks. Larger floors are usually split across two weekends rather than forced into one, and the stages are agreed at the walkthrough.

faq.question: Do you issue a certificate of insurance for our building manager?
faq.answer: We do. The certificate is $50 and is written to the wording and limits your management company sends us, naming the owner and the manager as required. Our carrier details, USDOT 3398018, MC 1153871 and CAL-T0192140, go on the same document. Forward the request as soon as you have a date and we file it before move week.

faq.question: Where will the truck sit while our office is loaded?
faq.answer: In your lot or loading area wherever that is possible. Glendora limits a commercial vehicle to one hour at the kerb in a commercial zone, and to two hours in a residential zone for anything over 7,000 pounds, so the day is built around short truck cycles rather than one long stand at the kerb. If a container has to stand on the street between stages, the Engineering Division at 116 E. Foothill Blvd. issues the permit for it.

faq.question: What does an office move in Glendora cost?
faq.answer: Two movers with a truck are $119 an hour cash or $129 by card Monday through Thursday, and $135 or $145 Friday through Sunday, with larger crews priced the same way. A three-hour minimum applies, four hours when the job sits 30 or more miles from our base, and travel is billed as double drive time past 10 miles. The walkthrough turns those rates into a figure for your suite.

faq.question: Can we move the office in stages instead of one day?
faq.answer: That is how most business relocations here are run. The archive and store room go first, then one department at a time, so each team is already working from new desks while the next one packs. Stages can sit on consecutive days or a week apart, and the hourly rate is the same for each visit.

faq.question: Do you handle loading where the building has no dock?
faq.answer: Yes, and it is common in the older commercial centres and in office and warehouse units such as those on E. Gladstone Street, where loading runs through a 10 by 10 foot overhead door. We measure the door and the ceiling height against the widest piece on the inventory before quoting, and bring machine dollies and ramps to suit whatever the building actually has.
